  filled                     80   32.5%
  REJECTED (API 404)         76   30.9%
  cancelled: timeout         56   22.8%

By series, rejected/attempts:
  KXMLBHR        22/22  100%
  KXMLBTOTAL     20/20  100%
  KXMLBSPREAD    12/12  100%
  KXITFWMATCH     4/4   100%
  KXITFMATCH      3/3   100%

MLB alone is 54 of the 76. The split is essentially binary per series, which rules out load, rate limits or a transient outage - the rejections are scattered across 41 separate hours rather than clustered, and a credential or config fault would fail everywhere rather than on six series.

HYPOTHESIS, not yet confirmed: the error text distinguishes 'Predictions', so these series appear to sit on a Kalshi product line the API user is not provisioned for. It could equally be a routing defect on our side for those series. Both are consistent with the evidence and they have different remedies, so the first task is to tell them apart - not to start excluding series.

WHY IT MATTERS beyond the wasted attempts: `live_fill_rate_pct` correctly excludes never-sent orders from its denominator, so the fill rate is honest. But `twin_mirror_coverage_pct` and the twin/live decision overlap do NOT know these markets were unplaceable - the twin opens them, live cannot, and the gap reads as though live declined a trade it actually was refused. Every capacity read on this canary is distorted by roughly a third until this is resolved or the series are excluded.

NO MONEY IS AT RISK from this: a rejected order places nothing.
